name: plastic tape
source:
Snapshots of a life through bandages.

You start your new life abroad with your phone and an opened box of eight bandages in your bag.

[From [url=https://npckc.itch.io/plastic-tape]Itch.io[/url]]

以创可贴串起的生活片段。

你带着手机，以及包里一盒已经拆封的8片装创可贴，开始了在异国的新生活。

[摘自[url=https://npckc.itch.io/plastic-tape]itch.io[/url]]
